findings.explanation_en: Your policy caps cataract at ₹40,000; the admissible amount exceeds it by ₹17,500.

explanations.en: Your policy caps cataract at ₹40,000; the admissible amount exceeds it by ₹17,500.

findings.fix: No fix will remove this cap before submission — you bear Rs.17,500. Ask hospital billing desk to confirm in writing that the final bill is for left eye only, and keep that note with your file. For any future right-eye cataract surgery, claim it as a separate episode to get a fresh Rs.40,000 per-eye limit; do not club both eyes in one bill.
